_agi_canonical.title: OP Cross-Chain Execution With Failure Branch
_agi_canonical.bar: Autonomous route selection over destination, deadline, execution-cost, and failed-attestation states.
_agi_canonical.derivation: Preferred received OP = (2,000-18)/2.10*(1-.0025)=941.45, arrives in 10 minutes on Optimism. Failed-attestation fallback takes 35 minutes and is deliberately reported as failing the deadline.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All public route-state outputs must match; prose is not token-graded.
